message: Datos de ejemplo: conecta tu API key de Upwork para ver ofertas reales.

jobs.t: Weibull reliability analysis for pump failures (MTBF, maintenance intervals)
jobs.d: Mining company needs an engineer to analyse failure history of 40 slurry pumps, fit Weibull distributions, estimate MTBF and propose preventive maintenance intervals. Deliverable: short report + Excel or Python notebook. Spanish speaker is a plus (team in Chile/Peru).

ai.encaje: Weibull, MTBF e intervalos de mantenimiento son tu terreno, y piden alguien que hable español con un equipo en Chile/Perú.
ai.riesgo: Piden nivel experto: muestra un ejemplo de ajuste Weibull ya hecho.
ai.apertura: With 40 slurry pumps and their failure history, the first step is to check whether failures are wear-out (β > 1) or random, because that decides whether preventive intervals make sense at all. I work with Weibull fitting, MTBF and RCM, and I can deliver the analysis as a Python notebook plus a short report, discussing results with your team in Spanish.
ai.pregunta: Do you have censored data (pumps still running), or only failure dates?

jobs.t: Excel inventory dashboard with reorder points and ABC analysis
jobs.d: We are a small distributor with ~800 SKUs. Need an Excel model that classifies items (ABC analysis), calculates safety stock and reorder points from 12 months of sales, and a simple dashboard for purchasing. Data is ready in CSV. Should take a few days.

ai.encaje: ABC, stock de seguridad y punto de reorden en Excel: es inventarios de libro, con cliente verificado y que gasta en Upwork.
ai.apertura: With 12 months of sales for ~800 SKUs you already have what is needed to set safety stock and reorder points properly. I would classify items with an ABC analysis, compute demand variability per class, and give your purchasing team a one-page Excel dashboard showing what to order and when.
ai.pregunta: What service level are you targeting for A items, and what are your supplier lead times?

jobs.t: Tutor de Ingeniería Industrial en español: investigación de operaciones
jobs.d: Busco tutor para 6 sesiones de programación lineal, inventarios (EOQ) y pronósticos para un curso universitario. Sesiones por Zoom, en español.

jobs.t: Spare parts criticality classification for a manufacturing plant
jobs.d: We have 4,000 spare parts with consumption, lead time and cost data. Looking for someone to build a criticality classification (multi-criteria) and suggest stocking policies. Academic background in this topic is a big plus.

ai.encaje: Es literalmente el tema de tu tesis: clasificación multicriterio de repuestos y políticas de stock. Pocos postulantes podrán mostrar algo así.
ai.riesgo: Plazo de 1–3 meses: acota bien el alcance de la primera entrega.
ai.apertura: Classifying 4,000 spare parts by criticality is exactly the problem I worked on in my thesis: I combined k-means clustering with TOPSIS and entropy weights to group parts into families and set (R,S) stocking policies for each. With your consumption, lead-time and cost data I would start by profiling the portfolio and proposing the criteria and weights with you, before building the classification.
ai.pregunta: Which criteria matter most to you today: downtime cost, lead time or inventory value?

jobs.t: FMEA and RCM workshop material for maintenance team
jobs.d: Need training material (slides + exercises) on FMEA, RCM and root cause analysis for a maintenance team at a water treatment plant. English, 1 module.

jobs.t: Demand forecasting in Python for 3 warehouses
jobs.d: Build a demand forecast (weekly) for ~200 products across 3 warehouses using pandas / statsmodels, and document accuracy (MAPE). Ongoing collaboration possible. Long term partner wanted.

jobs.t: Fix Power BI report: KPI cards showing wrong totals
jobs.d: Quick fix: our Power BI dashboard shows wrong totals in 3 KPI cards (DAX measure issue). Should be 1-2 hours for someone experienced.
